ITEM.PTXT: With an ETC card inserted in the toll collection (ETC) computer assembly, selecting the "Info/G" button on the HDD navigation receiver switches to the Info/G screen, and the "ETC" mark is displayed at the top of the screen (both the information screen and G-BOOK screen), allowing confirmation that the ETC card is inserted.
The ETC mark does not indicate that the vehicle can pass through ETC gates.
The ETC mark is displayed even if the ETC card has expired.
